Do not infer NIPAS status, no-take zoning, exact offshore boundaries or a separate beach-level protected-area polygon. The Supreme Court decision distinguishes the ecological/tourism purpose of Proclamation No. 1801 from land classification under Proclamation No. 1064; it does not invalidate the marine-reserve designation. The Philippine Coast Guard's 2019 NOSCOP Annex 10 also lists Boracay Island TZMR as a national MPA established in 1978 (SRC-051), but supplies only a reference point and no boundaries; the annex heading is not treated as proof of designation under the later NIPAS statute. Proclamation No. 1801 directs the Philippine Tourism Authority to delineate geographic areas; the Supreme Court identifies PTA Circular No. 3-82 (3 September 1982) as its implementing instrument, but the full circular and any boundary maps have not been recovered. protected_area_status.value: Boracay Islands were declared a Tourist Zone and Marine Reserve under Presidential Proclamation No. 1801 (10 November 1978). This is an island-level legal designation; beach-specific marine boundaries are not delineated in the proclamation.
protected_area_status.note: The designation is distinct from the later Boracay WQMACA under DENR AO 2019-15. Do not infer NIPAS status, no-take zoning, exact offshore boundaries or a separate beach-level protected-area polygon. The Supreme Court decision distinguishes the ecological/tourism purpose of Proclamation No. 1801 from land classification under Proclamation No. 1064; it does not invalidate the marine-reserve designation. The Philippine Coast Guard's 2019 NOSCOP Annex 10 also lists Boracay Island TZMR as a national MPA established in 1978 (SRC-051), but supplies only a reference point and no boundaries; the annex heading is not treated as proof of designation under the later NIPAS statute. Proclamation No. 1801 directs the Philippine Tourism Authority to delineate geographic areas; the Supreme Court identifies PTA Circular No. 3-82 (3 September 1982) as its implementing instrument, but the full circular and any boundary maps have not been recovered. Exact beach-level marine-reserve limits therefore remain unverified.
